_note: Daily-bar inside-bar trend-continuation strategy (course ep.12, 3rd use case). Tag: UPTREND only. Disabled by default - run isolated with `trader backtest --strategy inside_bar_breakout --start ... --end ... --label inside_bar_breakout_only`.

exit._note: TIGHT Chandelier Exit (highest close since entry - atr_mult*ATR(atr_period)), ratchet-only - shorter lookback/smaller multiple than breakout_trend's, since this is a short-horizon expansion play (small-range inside bar) meant to lock in a quick move, not ride a multi-month trend.
